m4_vs_m5_e1.root_cause: Omission of explicit bm25_weight=1.0 and dense_weight=1.0 in M5 E1 caused fallback to config settings 0.4/0.6, where dense passages consistently outranked BM25 matches. Reconciled run with 1.0/1.0 exactly matches M4 metrics (Hit@5=0.9231, MRR=0.4705).

e4_vs_e12_a1.root_cause: E4 without reranker was an isolated test of the baseline Hybrid retriever (version validation OFF). E12 A1 was a leave-one-out ablation of the Full Architecture (version validation ON). Version validation demoted non-current Ordinance passages, reducing MRR from 0.4064 to 0.3167.

e10_abstention_scale.root_cause: settings.evidence_min_score=0.35 is scaled for dense cosine similarities [0, 1]. In E10, raw RRF reciprocal scores (max 0.033) were passed, causing all 15 queries to fail threshold and trigger INSUFFICIENT.
